title: Execute and record release-critical runtime evidence
rootCause: Record meaningful runtime behavior evidence rather than only proposal acceptance or unexecuted opt-in scripts.

canonicalReleaseDecisionPath.decision: releaseEligible is true only when every mandatory gate is present, passed, current-candidate bound, and carries the required runtime-validation or functional-QA execution reference; missing or incomplete gates become explicit blockers.

correctionSummary: Added candidate-bound quality evidence, required runtime/QA execution references, fail-closed mandatory-gate evaluation, explicit evidence blockers, an executed local backend boundary fixture, structured runtime smoke output, and cg-14 support in the existing bounded verifier.

finding-4970556ab704416b2bf8.resolution: The release path now records explicit missing/incomplete gate blockers and never treats standalone or absent browser evidence as release eligibility. The repository Playwright wrapper was recorded as blocked by the validated QA workspace preflight; customer website generation E2E remained out of scope and was not run.

finding-191200ccc58b25e3fd0c.resolution: Opt-in smoke commands now emit structured not-run/non-release records unless explicitly authorized; executed generated-runtime evidence records validation identity, checksums, command results, and policy version.

finding-601d85f09cdb45d46400.resolution: Backend smoke retains proposal validation and additionally executes a temporary local migration/server-action boundary fixture, with no network or production database claim.
